subject: A frontal, symmetrical head-and-shoulders bust, eyes closed, plain carved-wood face, in a coarse, grainy, light grey-brown mail coif and broad mail shoulders reaching both edges, brown leather at the shoulders; across the brow, wider than the face, a flat sun-wheel of long pale-blue and white rays round a small gold ring with a dark-blue jewel, its top ray rising above the coif; no glow round him; all mid-tone sepia.
